summary:
Tested new Internal Linking feature end-to-end. Backend endpoint /api/prerender/internal-links returns correctly-shaped semantic link graph for all page types. Prerender proxy correctly injects grouped
sections, anchor tags, and JSON-LD (BreadcrumbList + SiteNavigationElement) for crawlers. Regular users continue to receive empty
(no injection). All 18 pytest tests passed on first run.
critical_code_review_comments: prerender-server.js injectMeta(): BreadcrumbList path-based names use generic title-case of URL slug (e.g., 'Smart Film') instead of the SEO-managed display name (e.g., 'GlassMorph Smart Film'). Consider reusing _get_name output by passing BreadcrumbList data from the backend /api/prerender/page endpoint for authoritative names.

internal_links.py: _name_cache is a module-level dict populated once on first request; if seed_col adds/renames pages later they will not show up until process restart. Consider a short TTL or explicit invalidation on SEO CMS updates.

internal_links.py: Branch order in build_links_for_page relies on elif chain. Homepage path '/' also matches the 'else' fallback if the hub block above adds it — but '/' is correctly handled earlier. Still, adding an explicit assertion / unit test that '/' never hits the generic else branch would harden it.

prerender-server.js buildSnippet(): All injected <nav> sections are direct children of <div id='root'> — when React hydrates it will replace this content, which is correct. However there is no explicit style='display:none' guard; if CSS is slow to load a crawler-only snippet may flash on the screen for real users on edge cases. Currently not an issue because crawler UA detection gates the injection.

success_rate.backend: 100% (8/8 API tests + 8/8 crawler HTML tests + 2/2 regular-user tests = 18/18)
success_rate.frontend: 100% (regular-user SPA behavior preserved, empty root div verified)

test_credentials: N/A — endpoint is public, no auth required
context_for_next_testing_agent: The internal linking feature is fully working. Test file /app/backend/tests/test_internal_links.py covers: (1) backend link-graph shape + rel types for home, product family, product subpage, knowledge article, geo-landing, solution subpages; (2) crawler HTML has grouped <nav aria-label='X'> blocks with labels like 'Products in This Range', 'Other Product Families', 'Part of', 'Also in This Range', 'Other Locations', 'Product Families', 'LED Screens by Location'; (3) JSON-LD BreadcrumbList + SiteNavigationElement schemas injected; (4) regular users still get empty root div. Run with: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_internal_links.py -v. Requests are serialized (0.6s sleep) to avoid the known prerender proxy concurrency issue documented in iteration 110.
rca of the issue: No issues found. Feature implemented correctly. Backend link graph covers all page types (product families, sub-products, knowledge articles, SEO landings, lifestyle, solutions, tools, content hubs, home). Prerender proxy injects semantic <nav> groups and JSON-LD correctly. Crawler UA gating works — regular users see no injection.
